newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN LEAGUE MATCHES ON SUNDAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN LEAGUE MATCHES ON SUNDAY.

text.p: Italian Serie A games due to be played on Sunday (all kick-off times GMT ):
Newly-promoted Bologna are one of the positive surprises of the season so far and the twin attack of Russian Igor Kolyvanov and Swede Kennet Andersson should prove too strong for Atalanta.

Relegation battlers Cagliari drop Uruguyan striker Dario Silva for a one-man attack of Giacomo Banchelli against an in- form Napoli due to be led by influential Brazilian midfielders Beto and Andre Cruz.
Full-strength Fiorentina, led by Brazilian Oliveira and Argentine captain Gabriel Batistuta, need to pick up home points against all-Italian Piacenza led by striker Pasquale Luiso.

This often high-scoring tie produced a 3-3 draw and a 6-3 Lazio win last season but may prove less spectacular this time. Sampdoria will be without Frenchman Christian Karembeu, at the centre of a protracted transfer to either Real Madrid or Barcelona in Spain, while Lazio will be without Italo-Australian midfielder Paul Okon.

The heat traditionally generated by a Milan derby will be stronger than ever given the reversal of recent roles, with Inter for once on top of AC Milan. A record crowd, full-strength sides and a partially restored pitch should mean that this will be one of the more memorable derbies, with Milan's Roberto Baggio and Liberian George Weah and Inter's Frenchman Youri Djorkaeff and Chilean Ivan Zamorano expected to play leading roles.

Parma and Roma are two of the biggest disappointments of the season so far. This is likely to be a dour battle, with Parma's Argentine striker Hernan Crespo battling against his compatriot and opposite number, Abel Balbo of Roma.
Battle of the newly promoted, both keen to avoid a quick return to Division Two but both as yet unconvincing in Serie A.
Last week, Vicenza missed an historic chance to go top of the table. With a little help from AC Milan in the derby, they could make amends this week against bottom side Reggiana.
